name: Hero
coverage: Navigator-hosted hero push and pop scenarios. Route presence on pop matches only in the sense that Flutter keeps the destination through its reverse flight and Incular removes it (navigation-005). Flight geometry is not comparable through probes: Flutter flight copies the probed child, so hero_to reports its destination rect (see findings md harness requests).

name: HeroController
coverage: Navigator-hosted hero push and pop scenarios with HeroController attached. Pop flight missing (navigation-005); push flight geometry not comparable through probes (harness requests). Create-rect-tween hooks covered by the existing heroes.rs tests.

name: HeroFlightDirection
coverage: Partial: pop direction would be exercised by navigation__hero__pop_flight_navigator; the route is removed before a reverse flight runs in Incular, so Pop is not produced there (navigation-005).

name: HeroMode
coverage: Partial: HeroMode enabled and placeholder behaviour is read at hero.rs:226 and covered by crates/incular/tests/heroes.rs:316 (placeholders_and_hero_mode). Not compared against Flutter in a frame twin.

name: NavigatorPopHandler
coverage: Partial reading: pop_scopes.rs:292 and :192. Not checked: attach and detach order. The route-level PopScope scenario covers the dispatch-callback path only.

name: HeroControllerScope
coverage: Searched rg for HeroControllerScope and hero_controller_scope: none. Incular attaches a HeroController explicitly with HeroController::attach(&navigator) (hero_controller.rs). Whether an application shell attaches one by default was not checked; open question, not a finding.

name: kDefaultRouteDirectionalTraversalEdgeBehavior
coverage: Focus traversal constant, owned by focus_input (reassign). Searched rg for traversal_edge, TraversalEdge and directional_traversal: none in crates. Not a navigation behaviour in this audit.

name: kDefaultRouteTraversalEdgeBehavior
coverage: Focus traversal constant, owned by focus_input (reassign). Searched rg for traversal_edge and TraversalEdge: none in crates.

name: NavigationNotification
coverage: Partial reading: Incular NavigationNotification (router.rs:764-770) carries kind, route information, can_handle_pop and error for router events. Flutter Navigator canPop notifications are not mapped one-to-one and were not compared.

name: Navigator
coverage: Scenarios on a Navigator-hosted outlet (mount_navigator, host.rs): fade push and pop timelines (route opacity and presence), observer_order (push, replace, pop; values match), and pop_scope_route_back_blocked. Frame-level matches: observer_order log and the PopScope callback counts. Divergences: pop removes the route at once (navigation-003, navigation-005); covered route hidden from push start (navigation-010). Not checked: pushAndRemoveUntil, popUntil and removeRoute (no Incular API; navigation-002).

name: NavigatorObserver
coverage: navigation__navigator__observer_order: didPush (initial and push), didReplace (pushReplacement / Replaced) and didPop, as an ordered log (1, 11, 112, 1123), matches on both sides. Not checked: didRemove, didStartUserGesture, previousRoute arguments, and RouteAware (not added this pass).

name: NavigatorState
coverage: Partial: the Navigator-hosted twins exercise push, pushReplacement (Incular replace), pop and maybePop. pushAndRemoveUntil, popUntil and removeRoute are missing (navigation-002).

name: Page
coverage: Partial reading: Page (presentation.rs:27-236) carries a key, a child, presentation and transition. The frame twin uses Route::new instead of Page, and set_pages reconciliation (navigator.rs:661) is not exercised.

name: RestorableRouteFuture
coverage: rg for RestorableRouteFuture and RouteFuture found nothing in crates. Restorable routes are RestorableRoute (incular-navigation route_data.rs; tests/navigation.rs:627). Restoration harness not built in this pass.

name: Route
coverage: Partial: route presence and opacity sampled through the fade push and pop timelines. Route lifecycle callbacks (didChangeNext, didComplete) not checked; RouteResult read only. The covered route is hidden at push start in Incular (navigation-010).

name: RoutePopDisposition
coverage: Partial reading: PopDecision (navigator.rs:69) has only Allow and Deny. Flutter bubble (hand the pop to the parent) is not represented on a route guard; parent chaining is covered by BackDispatcher::dispatch_back_with_fallback (back_dispatch.rs:479). Not compared with a frame twin.

name: RouteSettings
coverage: Partial reading: RouteSettings (route_data.rs:356) holds the route name and arguments. Used only indirectly by the navigator scenario. Not checked: equality rules and the arguments type.

name: Overlay
coverage: Partial reading: Incular Overlay (presentation.rs:658-700) is a value holding entries, with insert, remove_top and dismiss_top. No Overlay widget with initialEntries is exercised, so widget ordering and lifecycle are not compared. Per-entry removal and rebuild are missing (navigation-004).

name: OverlayChildLayoutInfo
coverage: Partial reading: the info is passed to the overlay child builder (navigation_scopes.rs:59). The overlay_portal scenarios position content with constants and never read info fields (child size and offset), so those fields are not compared.

name: OverlayChildLocation
coverage: Internal location record behind Flutter overlay layout info; its observable effect is the layout info covered (partially) by OverlayChildLayoutInfo. Searched rg for child_location and OverlayChildLocation: none.

name: OverlayEntry
coverage: Partial reading: OverlayEntry (presentation.rs:569) holds a child, a modal barrier and dismissibility, with no builder, removal handle or rebuild method. Per-entry lifecycle is missing (navigation-004).

name: OverlayPortal
coverage: Scenarios: show and hide with a centered anchor (navigation__overlay_portal__show_hide, matches over 7 frames); popup geometry and tap outside a 100x100 anchor clip (content_outside_anchor_clip, matches); a direct anchor child (direct_anchor, diverges on the anchor probe because the portal replaces the child key, navigation-009). Pixel scene overlay_portal_ancestor_clip shows the popup missing in Incular (navigation-007). Reading: navigation_scopes.rs:155-240.

name: OverlayPortalController
coverage: Searched rg for portal_controller and OverlayPortalController: none. Incular shows and hides with the declarative OverlayPortal::show(bool); navigation__overlay_portal__show_hide drives it in the same frames as Flutter controller.show() and hide(). Controller isShowing and listener semantics are not checked.

name: OverlayState
coverage: Partial reading: the Incular Overlay value (presentation.rs:658) is the closest analogue; insert, remove_top and dismiss_top exist. Insert-relative and rearrange are missing (navigation-004).

name: PageRoute
coverage: Partial: fade transitions covered through PageRouteBuilder rows. Secondary animation of the route below is not compared (Flutter probe does not show the expected 0.5, unresolved; see findings md open questions). Transition builder hooks not checked.

name: PageRouteBuilder
coverage: Scenarios: fade push and pop timelines with 300 ms forward and reverse duration (Flutter) against Incular RouteTransition::fade_in (no reverse). Push timing matches within a 1.3 ms harness residual (base captured before runtime mount). Pop: Flutter keeps the route for the reverse duration; Incular removes it at once (navigation-003). Default jump-cut defaults (presentation.rs:351) are reading only.

name: PerformanceOverlay
coverage: Debug performance overlay widget (debug tooling), not a navigation or route behaviour.

name: PopScope
coverage: navigation__pop_scope__route_back_blocked (route-level PopScope with canPop false): onPopInvokedWithResult callback count and popped value match with the route kept, through the Navigator back action (Flutter maybePop, Incular dispatcher). Root opacity under a covered route differs only while the top route is opaque (not visible). Not checked: canPop true result values, dispatch via handlePopRoute.

name: RawMenuOverlayInfo
coverage: Menu-anchor overlay geometry record for RawMenuAnchor. Menu anchor geometry belongs to menus, not to route or overlay-route behaviour; Incular counterpart raw_menu_anchor.rs:22 was not compared here.

name: BackButtonDispatcher
coverage: Partial reading: app-shell BackButtonDispatcher (router.rs:635-685) is a newest-first callback list, matching Flutter first refusal. Child creation and takePriority or deferTo are missing from this type (navigation-006). No back-event frame twin.

name: BackButtonListener
coverage: Unchecked: needs a Router-hosted back-dispatch twin. A system back input now exists (Dart h.back(), Rust BackDispatcher::dispatch_back), but the Incular frame host presents a Navigator outlet, not a Router with a root back dispatcher, so BackButtonListener priority under Router cannot be driven equivalently. Incular counterpart: crates/incular-widgets pop_scopes.rs:414 (not compared). Router back priority is source-reviewed in navigation-006.

name: ChildBackButtonDispatcher
coverage: Partial reading: a separate navigation dispatcher has create_child (back_dispatch.rs:413-420) and defer_to (:423-428), but the Router accepts only the app-shell RootBackButtonDispatcher, so nested Routers cannot use child priority through RouterConfig (navigation-006).

name: PlatformRouteInformationProvider
coverage: Unchecked: needs a browser history harness (page URL and history entries). incular-web/src/history.rs:97 is wasm-only; not in the frame harness.

name: PopNavigatorRouterDelegateMixin

name: RootBackButtonDispatcher
